Mia: Quick check — we need 4 spare A100s in eu-west1 overnight for a demo (23:00-03:00 UTC). Vendor can loan but requires tenant allowlist + quota lift. Anyone able to own this?
Alex: I'm on infra oncall tonight, I can take it. What tenant ID/project? Dedicated preferred or is preemptible OK?
Mia: Tenant=prod-demo-42, project=rdw-demo. Dedicated pool preferred but preemptible acceptable if we risk-manage. Vendor wants an allowlist rule (CIDR 10.14.32.0/24) and quota bumped to 8 GPUs.
Sam: I'll open the GCP quota ticket and ping vendor. Note: there's an unmerged quota PR in terraform; I'll link here.
Sam: PR snippet to run locally: `terraform apply -var='project=rdw-demo' -target=google_compute_project_metadata` — will attach PR shortly.
ProcurementBot: Ticket created: GCP quota request #Q-98321 (prod-demo-42). ETA 6-12h.
Lee: Heads-up — finance needs a quick signoff if we bump to 8 GPUs for billing. Looping in now.
Alex: I can apply the allowlist firewall. Pushing branch `infra/allowlist-demo-6623`. Firewall snippet: ```hcl
resource "google_compute_firewall" "vendor-allow" {
  name         = "vendor-allow-rdw-demo"
  network      = "default"
  source_ranges = ["10.14.32.0/24"]
  allow = [{ protocol = "tcp" ports = ["22","9090"] }]
}
```
Mia: Thanks. If quota isn't approved by 21:00 UTC, fallback plan: borrow 2 A100 from demo pool now + spin up remaining as preemptible. @Alex can you confirm borrow path?
Alex: Confirmed. I'll try to get full patch merged by 20:30 UTC and will post updates. If borrowing required I'll claim 2 from `demo-standby` and notify the owner.
Sam: Merged the quota PR and requested expedite with priority=P2 on Q-98321. Vendor also pinged on their side.
Mia: :thumbsup: I'll notify PM and run smoke harness once infra reports green. If anything blocks, I'll update here.
ProcurementBot: Vendor confirms soft-reserve until 21:30 UTC (vendor-ops).
Lee: Finance approved a short-term bump for the demo budget.
Alex: Status update: firewall applied, vendor IAM granted to vendor-sa@redwood-demo, quota PR merged. I'll monitor logs and adjust if IAM errors crop up. If we see eviction risk I'll revert to preemptible plan.
Mia: Perfect — running smoke on staging at 21:50 UTC. Thanks everyone.
